name: Shirosato (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shirosato town emblem in white: a stylised flame-like device enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shirosato, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 March 2005.

features.role: Shirosato town emblem — a stylised flame-like device enclosing a disc
